sam_support: Customer cust-824 reporting their embeddings pipeline started failing after a pinned model change. They say the embedding length jumped and their downstream index throws a shape error. :grimacing:

sam_support: Minimal repro customer provided:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large@pinned-2024-12-01","input":"foo"}'
# before: embedding length = 1536
# after: embedding length = 2048
```

sam_support: They say they pinned `redwood-embed-large@pinned-2024-12-01` last month. We auto-applied a hotfix this morning and they started seeing failures around 2025-01-12T09:40Z.

alice_eng: Quick Q: was the alias `pinned-2024-12-01` supposed to be immune to the hotfixer? I thought pinned aliases were excluded.

linda_ml: They are. The hotfixer has an allowlist but there was a regex edge-case when the alias contained `large` and `pinned` together. Patcher mapped `redwood-embed-large@pinned-2024-12-01` -> `redwood-embed-large@v2.0-quant` which has a different projection head and thus 2048 dims.

jordan_sre: I pulled the request id the customer sent: rwd-req-55412. Worker log snippet shows:
```
[2025-01-12T09:40:02Z] resolve alias pinned-2024-12-01 -> redwood-embed-large@v2.0-quant
[2025-01-12T09:40:02Z] model_meta.embedding_dim=2048
[2025-01-12T09:40:02Z] served request id=rwd-req-55412
```

sam_support: Customer included response headers from the failing call:
```
x-redwood-variant: pinned-2024-12-01
x-redwood-runtime: rt-gpu-4
x-request-id: rwd-req-55412
```

alice_eng: Can the hotfix tool produce an audit trail? We need to see when and why the alias pointer changed.

linda_ml: Yes. The hotfix audit shows a mass pointer update at 2025-01-12T09:39:58Z. The change list included 72 artifacts; our exclusion rule used a substring match that failed for aliases containing `-2024-12-01` (edge-case).

product_pm: Customer impact: their embeddings index is failing; they have a nightly job that crashed and they lost 6 hours of throughput. They're requesting a rollback to the exact artifact they pinned and a guarantee this won't happen again.

jordan_sre: Short-term plan: rebind alias pinned-2024-12-01 back to the exact artifact hash for v1.9 (the original). I can run the rebind on eu-central-1 reserved pools; propagation ETA ~45m. Will coordinate with infra.

deploy-bot: [action] hotfix-mapping applied at 2025-01-12T09:39:58Z by hotfixer-service
deploy-bot: [action] rebind started pinned-2024-12-01 -> redwood-embed-large@v1.9 (requested by jordan_sre)

alice_eng: Longer-term fixes:
- Don't use substring matching in hotfixer; require explicit alias metadata tags (pinned=true).
- Add a preflight validation step that compares model_meta.embedding_dim before remap; if dims differ, fail unless a force flag present and customer opt-in recorded.
- Add an alert to support when a rebind changes embedding dims for any alias with `pinned` or `lock` in the name.

linda_ml: Also add a lightweight compatibility shim in serving that can detect a mismatched dim and return a structured error with suggestion: "alias points to model with embedding_dim X but expected Y; contact support or rebind alias". This avoids silent failures in downstream indexers.

sam_support: Told the customer we'd perform rebind and offered to help reindex or provide a temporary compat layer if they can't reindex quickly. They asked for ETA and an SLA credit.

jordan_sre: Rebind finished at 2025-01-12T10:22:30Z. I verified with a sample request from the customer's key; now returns embedding length 1536 (matches their previous v1.9 artifact). 

sam_support: Customer validated and marked green. They've requested a postmortem and a written rundown of the preventative steps.

product_pm: I'll own the postmortem and schedule a customer-facing RCA and the opt-in flow for embedding-dim changes.

alice_eng: I'll open a PR to hotfixer to replace substring allowlist with explicit tag checks and include unit tests for pinned alias exclusion.

linda_ml: I'll add the metadata-dim preflight gate and the serve-time friendly error message.

sam_support: Action items summarized for handoff:
- Rebind alias to v1.9 (done) (jordan_sre)
- Hotfixer exclusion bug fix (alice_eng)
- Preflight model_meta dim validation (linda_ml)
- Add serve-time mismatch error and docs (linda_ml/product_pm)
- Customer RCA and SLA discussion (product_pm/support)

sam_support: Closing thread once RCA is sent. Customer satisfied for now. :white_check_mark:
